newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rio state publishes rules for gas company sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Rio state publishes rules for gas company sell-off.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state government published Wednesday the rules for the privatization of its gas company Companhia Estadual de Gas (CEG) and piped gas distributor Riogas on July 10, the Rio Planning office said.

The state government will sell 58.87 percent of CEG's voting capital together with a 83.6 percent voting stake in Riogas, a company which was created early this year to distribute piped gas in the the state, the Planning Secretariat said in a statement.

Consortia interested in bidding for CEG and Riogas must include a company from the sector and will have to hold at least 15 percent of CEG's shares and 25 percent of Riogas's total capital for five years.
CEG employees will be allowed to purchase 6.5 percent of the company's shares, a package equivalent to 10 percent of the state's total stake in the gas firm, it added.
The privatization will take place through a closed-envelope sale on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
